messages:
Zoe (People Ops): Heads up — candidate Lukas (SWE) is requesting a visa invitation letter for a B1 appointment in Berlin so he can come onsite to SF next month. He also asked about loaner Windows machine and vegetarian meal.
Arjun (Recruiter): Thanks. He can do a 09:00 PT start on Mon the 14th. Panelers are in PST and CET. Sofia, can panel line up at that PT start?
Sofia (Hiring Manager): 09:00 PT is OK. We'll stagger interviews so CET folks join later. Suggest flow: 09:009:45 coding, 09:4510:30 break & travel buffer, 10:3011:15 system design, 11:1511:30 debrief.
Zoe (People Ops): Noted. For the visa letter: please include travel dates, company contact, and confirmation that Redwood will host the onsite loop. I'll draft and send a PDF signed by Legal. Anyone object?
Ben (Facilities): For onsite logistics: we need reception to prepare guest badge and building access. Also advise on shuttle from SFO to campus if he lands early.
Arjun (Recruiter): Policy check: international travel reimbursement up to $300 USD for interviews; taxis and ground transport OK with receipts. I'll tell Lukas.
Zoe (People Ops): Loaner request: he wants Windows 11 dev laptop. Inventory shows 2 in US pool. @ITAssetBot can you reserve and ship overnight to the candidate's Airbnb? He provided travel address in SF.
ITAssetBot: Reserved 1x Lenovo X1 Carbon (Windows 11) from US pool. Shipping scheduled via Redwood Courier, ETA to address by Fri before his arrival. Tracking: RC123456789.
Arjun (Recruiter): Shipping ETA good. Lukas also asked if we cover visa appointment fees if needed. Policy: we don't cover government visa fees, only travel and lodging related to interview. I'll be explicit.
Zoe (People Ops): Accessibility/diet: Lukas is vegetarian and prefers quiet interview room. Facilities, please assign a quiet ground-floor room and mark calendar.
Ben (Facilities): Quiet room reserved (Bldg 3, Room G12). I'll add note for catering: vegetarian boxed lunch and a label for any allergies.
Sofia (Hiring Manager): One more ask: Lukas wants to do the coding task on the laptop but prefers VS Code with a specific extension pack. Can IT preload it?
ITAssetBot: Confirmed: VS Code + extensions (Go, Python, Prettier) will be preinstalled. Laptop will be image-locked and return label included.
Zoe (People Ops): Visa letter draft:
```
Redwood Inference
Attn: Consular Officer
This letter confirms that Mr. Lukas Meyer has been invited to attend an onsite interview at Redwood Inference, 123 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA between June 12
and June 16, 2026. Redwood will provide local hospitality and coordinate interview scheduling. For questions contact Zoe (People Ops) at zoe@redwood.example or +1-415-555-0102.
```
Please review.
Arjun (Recruiter): Looks good. I'll send to Lukas with next steps and mention the reimbursement policy + shipping tracking.
ShippingBot: Package RC123456789 status: picked up from warehouse. Expected delivery Thu 08:009:00 PT. Customs paperwork attached to order.
Zoe (People Ops): Reminder: NDA must be signed before coding task. Arjun, can you attach the DocuSign and flag Greenhouse stage as "final loop scheduled"?
Arjun (Recruiter): Done. DocuSign sent; Lukas signed within 2h. Greenhouse updated.
Sofia (Hiring Manager): After the loop please ensure everyone completes the standard scorecard in Greenhouse within 24h. Also, panel please add any notes about remote vs onsite differences since some panelers will be remote.
Ben (Facilities): I'll add parking code for guest (if candidate drives): G7-42. Also will prep a printed return label inside the loaner box.
Zoe (People Ops): Perfect. Final checklist: visa letter sent, loaner reserved & shipping tracked, quiet room & vegetarian lunch confirmed, DocuSign done. If anything slips, ping me. :white_check_mark:
